crossRefs.note: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews…
“Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

translations.web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
translations.bsb: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
translations.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words,
translations.asv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:
